grades: Grades 9 to 12; most programs are for rising juniors and seniors
name: Maryville University Pre-College Summer Programs
what_you_do: High school students try college-style programs. Topics are science, cybersecurity, health careers, sport business, business and design. Each program lasts one day to one week.
who_can_apply: High school students. Most programs are for rising juniors and seniors. The Health Professions Summer Institute also takes rising sophomores. The design and art program takes students in grades 9 to 12.
pay_detail: 2026 fees: $65 portfolio workshop, $75 Cybersecurity, $85 Biz Camp, $100 Saints Science Academy, $150 Health Professions, $700 Rawlings Sport Business (lodging and meals included).
deadline_text: The 2026 programs ran in June and July. 2026 registration dates ran from May 25 to July 27. Dates for 2027 are not posted on the program page.
how_to_apply: Watch the program page in spring. Each program has its own registration. Fees vary by program.
notes: Pick the program that fits your grade. Fees are from 2026 and may change.
